items.title: Higher Cost of Capital Will Impact Credit: Gibbons
items.title_ko: Higher Cost of Capital Will Impact Credit: Gibbons
items.summary_ko: Maureen O’Connor, global head of high-grade debt syndicate at Wells Fargo, and Suzanne Gibbons, partner and head of research at Davidson Kempner, join Scarlet Fu on “Bloomberg Real Yield.” They discuss the departure of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, how his exit will affect AI debt financing, and the rising cost of capital. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Govt. Action Around Huang Affair Reveals Lack of Guardrails, Says Rep. Dexter
items.title_ko: Govt. Action Around Huang Affair Reveals Lack of Guardrails, Says Rep. Dexter
items.summary_ko: Democratic Representative Maxine Dexter talked about her bill to ban new data centers on federal public lands and the potential national security risks posed by the Nvidia scandal. Dexter said that the government inaction around Huang's affair reveals a lack of guardrails and regulations around national security.

items.title: AI Financing Strong Despite Nvidia: Rosenbaum
items.title_ko: AI Financing Strong Despite Nvidia: Rosenbaum
items.summary_ko: Nathaniel Rosenbaum, head of US high grade strategy at JPMorgan, says Nvidia’s turmoil is unlikely to have broader ramifications for investment-grade credit, while hyperscalers continue to find financing for the AI buildout. “At the right price there will be demand for that debt,” Rosenbaum says on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
